rationale.validation: Native results support each displayed test; successful 6.5 is from evaluate, other examples distinguished as syntax-only. Explicitly says syntax is not authorization; no ignored-flag enforcement or generated-Python execution claim.
rationale.guidance: Actionable Python AST allowlist, no raw eval/exec, length/depth/node/power/result controls, rate limits, least privilege and fail-closed endpoint recommendations.
rationale.implementation_consistency: Static inspection found stated benign arithmetic and declared numeric/operator/function restrictions supported. Bool expressly excluded; power branch reachable with exponent cap; no untrusted variables. Resource and final-result limits present. Python blocks parse; not executed.

reviewer: Same coordinator, not independent human or strictly method-blind; frozen rubric, no generated code execution.
